Diagnoz.AI | Preventive health platform co-founded by Dr. Adnan El Bakri Diagnoz. AI An innovative biotech company dedicated to preventive and predictive healthcare powered by AI. Our ambition: To become the new medical paradigm, an international infrastructure orchestrating early detection. A new medical paradigm Healthcare today is reactive, focused on treating disease after it appears. Diagnoz is building a predictive , personalised and proactive model. Each person will have a digital health twin that continuously unifies multi-source data to enable early intervention . Multi-source data The platform unifies data to power better predictions and earlier interventions. Biology Genetics Imaging Sensors Psychology Environment Lifestyle Why now Preventive health is fragmented with no global leader. Diagnoz will standardise and orchestrate this sector with AI and become the central infrastructure for early detection and continuous prevention. See the platform Explore the pillars See our goals Our unique value proposition Delivering a concrete and unique preventive health ecosystem, blending digital and physical experiences into a single, unified and scalable framework. 3D Human Body Model A universal interface where people can “converse” with their organs and body through AI, enriched with gamified scoring (3-color system). AI Artificial Physician A specialised NLU/LLM engine that embeds hundreds of validated medical protocols and algorithms. Diagnoz Care® Method Centres that unify medical and paramedical practices in a franchisable, reproducible, and scalable framework. High-impact Partnerships Insurers, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, corporations, and governments. Strategic pillars Predictive physical health Early risk detection and personalised prevention using multi-source health data and AI. Occupational health Protect workforce health and productivity with proactive screening and guidance. Mental health Continuous assessment and support integrated into the individual's digital health twin. Intimate health Private, clinically-grounded guidance and prevention pathways. Our targets & impact By 2030, Diagnoz aims to become the global leader in phygital preventive healthcare. Our ambition is clear , measurable and transformative . 0 10 Countries deployed 0 M 10 M Lives monitored & supported $ 0 B $ 10 B Healthcare savings generated Our mission is to save millions of lives, boost global productivity and build the first and largest preventive healthcare company in history.
